executive_assessment.text: The CCDR links Grand Sud drought and cyclone flooding with crop/livelihood losses, high prices and food insecurity; over two million faced acute hunger in the 2020-2022 crisis, also involving COVID price shocks.
The CCDR reports early marriage, transactional sex and school dropout as Grand Sud drought-period concerns for women and girls.

known_gaps.text: The NDC's 2026 figures are summarized in French, and the opened Grand Sud CCDR passage does not isolate climate's contribution to violence; no country-specific causal estimate of climate effects on conflict was opened.

The bank contains no completed mediated climate-FCV pathway; this is an evidence gap, not evidence of absence.
